effects: Adds the url to the signer's list of offchain storage roots in the Accounts registry. No assets move.
formats.shown: Intent 'Add Storage Root' and the URL as raw bytes.

findings.title: addStorageRoot shows the URL as hex bytes, not readable text.
findings.evidence: descriptor addStorageRoot: field path 'url', format 'raw'; ABI type is bytes, so wallets render hex.
findings.fix: No ERC-7730 format decodes bytes as UTF-8 text. Keep as is, or change the contract to take a string.

formats.key: authorizeAttestationSigner(address signer, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Makes `signer` the attestation signer of the signer's Celo account. The signer's proof-of-possession signature (v, r, s) is checked. The signer address can then sign attestations for the account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Signer', the signer address and the sender as Authorizer; v, r, s hidden.

findings.title: authorizeAttestationSigner intent 'Authorize Signer' does not say the role is attestation.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeAttestationSigner: "intent": "Authorize Signer"; the same intent is used by authorizeSigner, authorizeSignerWithSignature and completeSignerAuthorization.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Authorize attestation signer".

effects: Starts a two-step authorization: records that the signer's account proposes `signer` for `role`. The authorization only takes effect when `signer` calls completeSignerAuthorization.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Signer', the signer address and the role as a raw 32-byte hash.

findings.title: authorizeSigner shows the role as a raw bytes32 hash; the right granted is unreadable.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeSigner: field 'role', label 'Role', format 'raw'. Roles are keccak256 hashes such as keccak256("celo.org/core/vote").
findings.fix: Add a description or map for the known role hashes (vote, validator, attestation) if the spec allows; otherwise state in the label that it is a role hash.

findings.title: authorizeSigner intent names the final goal; this call only proposes the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeSigner: "intent": "Authorize Signer"; in Celo Accounts.authorizeSigner the authorization stays incomplete until the signer calls completeSignerAuthorization.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Propose signer for role".

formats.key: authorizeSignerWithSignature(address signer, bytes32 role, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Authorizes `signer` for `role` on the signer's account in one step, using the signer's signature as proof of possession. The signer address can then act for the account in that role.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Signer', the signer address, the role as a raw hash; v, r, s hidden.

findings.title: authorizeSignerWithSignature shows the granted role as a raw bytes32 hash.
findings.fix: Label the known role hashes, or rename the field to 'Role hash'.

formats.key: authorizeValidatorSigner(address signer, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Makes `signer` the validator signer of the signer's account, after a proof-of-possession check. The signer address can then sign validator operations for the account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Validator' and the Validator Signer address; v, r, s hidden.

findings.title: authorizeValidatorSigner intent 'Authorize Validator' reads as approving a validator, not a signer key.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeValidatorSigner: "intent": "Authorize Validator"; the function sets the account's validator signer.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Authorize validator signer".

formats.key: authorizeValidatorSignerWithPublicKey(address signer, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s, bytes ecdsaPublicKey)
effects: Makes `signer` the validator signer of the signer's account.
Updates the validator's ECDSA public key in the Validators contract to `ecdsaPublicKey`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Validator', the signer address and the public key as raw bytes; v, r, s hidden.

findings.title: authorizeValidatorSignerWithPublicKey intent omits the signer role and the public key update.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeValSignerPK: "intent": "Authorize Validator"; field 'ecdsaPublicKey' label 'Public Key'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Authorize validator signer and key".

formats.key: authorizeVoteSigner(address signer, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Makes `signer` the vote signer of the signer's account. The signer address can then vote in Election and Governance with the account's locked CELO.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize & Set Vote' and the Authorized Signer address; v, r, s hidden.

findings.title: authorizeVoteSigner intent 'Authorize & Set Vote' suggests casting a vote; it delegates voting rights.
findings.evidence: descriptor authorizeVoteSigner: "intent": "Authorize & Set Vote"; the function only sets the account's vote signer, no vote is cast.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Authorize vote signer".

effects: The caller accepts a pending authorization: the caller's address becomes a signer of `account` for `role` and is bound to that account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize Signer', the Authorizing Account and the Role ID as a raw hash.

findings.title: completeSignerAuthorization intent says 'Authorize Signer'; the caller accepts becoming another account's signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor completeSignerAuthorization: "intent": "Authorize Signer", field 'account' label 'Authorizing Account'. The caller binds its own address to `account`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Accept signer role for account".

findings.title: completeSignerAuthorization shows the role as a raw bytes32 hash.
findings.evidence: descriptor completeSignerAuthorization: field 'role', label 'Role ID', format 'raw'.

effects: Registers the signer's address as a Celo account. No assets move.
formats.shown: Intent 'Create Account' and the sender as Account Owner.

effects: Deletes the signer's validator payment delegation, so no share of future validator payments goes to the old beneficiary.
formats.shown: Intent 'Delete Delegation' and the sender's account.

findings.title: deletePaymentDelegation intent 'Delete Delegation' can be read as removing vote or stake delegation.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Delete payment delegation".

effects: Removes the attestation signer of the signer's account; attestation authority returns to the account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Signer' and the sender's account.

findings.title: removeAttestationSigner intent does not say which signer role is removed.
findings.evidence: descriptor removeAttestationSigner: "intent": "Remove Signer"; removeValidatorSigner and removeDefaultSigner use the same intent.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Remove attestation signer".

effects: Clears the default signer of the signer's account for `role`. The signer's completed role authorization is not revoked by this call.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Signer', the sender's account and the role as a raw hash.

findings.title: removeDefaultSigner says 'Remove Signer' but only clears the default signer for the role.
findings.evidence: descriptor removeDefaultSigner: "intent": "Remove Signer". In Celo Accounts the function resets the default signer; removeSigner is the call that revokes the authorization.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Remove default signer for role".

findings.title: removeDefaultSigner shows the role as a raw bytes32 hash.

effects: Removes the indexed signer of the signer's account for `role`; the role falls back to the account itself.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Signer' and the role as a raw hash.

findings.title: removeIndexedSigner shows only a raw role hash; the removed role is unreadable.
findings.evidence: descriptor removeIndexedSigner: intent "Remove Signer"; single field 'role', format 'raw'.
findings.fix: Label the known role hashes and change the intent to "Remove signer for role".

effects: Revokes the authorization of `signer` for `role` on the signer's account; if it was the default signer, the default is cleared too.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Signer', the signer address and the role as a raw hash.

findings.title: removeSigner shows the role as a raw bytes32 hash.

effects: Removes the storage root at `index` from the signer's list of offchain storage roots.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Root', the index and the sender's account.

findings.title: removeStorageRoot shows the index only; the URL removed lives in storage.
findings.evidence: descriptor removeStorageRoot: field 'index' format 'raw'; the URL at that index is read from contract storage.

effects: Removes the validator signer of the signer's account; validator authority returns to the account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Signer' and the sender's account.

findings.title: removeValidatorSigner intent does not say the validator signer is removed.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Remove validator signer".

effects: Removes the vote signer of the signer's account; voting authority returns to the account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Remove Vote Signer' and the sender's account.

effects: Sets the metadata URL of the signer's account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set Metadata URL' and the URL text.

effects: Sets the display name of the signer's account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set Account Name' and the name text.

effects: Sends `fraction` (a Fixidity value, 1e24 = 100%) of the signer's future validator payments to `beneficiary`. It replaces any previous payment delegation.
formats.shown: Intent 'Delegate Payment', the beneficiary and the fraction as a percent (decimals 22).

findings.title: setPaymentDelegation intent does not say a share of future validator payments goes to the beneficiary.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Share validator payments with beneficiary" and label the fraction 'Share of validator payments'.
